statement.name: getAll
statement.sql: select object_type_id as targetObjectType, object_id as targetObjectID from Workflow.dbo.PROCESS_INSTANCE_CONTEXT

statement.name: getMsg
statement.sql:
select mm.* from Workflow.dbo.PROCESS_INSTANCE_CONTEXT fic inner join MAIL_MESSAGE mm on fic.object_id = mm.messageId
4

statement.name: getApp
statement.sql:
select app.* from Workflow.dbo.PROCESS_INSTANCE_CONTEXT fic inner join APPLICATIONS app on fic.object_id = app.applicationId
11

statement.name: getGrant
statement.sql:
select gr.* from Workflow.dbo.PROCESS_INSTANCE_CONTEXT fic inner join GRANTS gr on fic.object_id = gr.grantId
12

statement.name: getGrantThruApp
statement.sql:
select gr.* from Workflow.dbo.PROCESS_INSTANCE_CONTEXT fic inner join APPLICATIONS app on fic.object_id = app.applicationId inner join GRANTS gr on app.grantId = gr.grantId
11

statement.name: getProg
statement.sql:
select prog.* from Workflow.dbo.PROCESS_INSTANCE_CONTEXT fic inner join PROGRAMS prog on fic.object_id = prog.programId
13

statement.name: getProgThruApp
statement.sql:
select distinct prog.* from Workflow.dbo.PROCESS_INSTANCE_CONTEXT fic inner join APPLICATIONS app on fic.object_id = app.applicationId inner join FUNDINGCYCLES fc on app.fundingCycleId = fc.fundingCycleId inner join PROGRAMS prog on fc.programId = prog.programId
11

statement.name: getProgThruGrant
statement.sql:
select distinct prog.* from Workflow.dbo.PROCESS_INSTANCE_CONTEXT fic inner join GRANTS gr on fic.object_id = gr.grantId inner join PROGRAMS prog on gr.programId = prog.programId
12
